body.interaction_rule: Separation Documentation: Retain in the separated employee's file: (1) termination letter or notice, (2) reason for termination (performance, RIF, conduct, etc.), (3) final pay calculation and check stub, (4) accrued leave balance at termination, (5) final paycheck delivery date/method, (6) any severance agreement, release, or non-compete signed. Retain all documents for 4 years after termination per payroll-record rules (O.C.G.A. § 34-4-5).
